page.layout: Title block at full width (two lines of title, then "INDEX."). Below it two columns: left column, A entries, complete; right column, M entries, cut off after its first two lines. No margin notes, no running head, no page number visible.; One column of alphabetical index entries, each with its page numbers at the right. Continues the page from the previous scan. A last line at the foot, at left, with page numbers.
page.notes: The right column is cut off after its first two lines; only the visible part is transcribed. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "Accclius" (possibly Accilius), "Hierace" and the page number 18 on the last visible line. "acacallis" and "acalanthis" carry an ornamental mark before the word that I could not identify; it is omitted. The tilde over "acaretũ" and "Actolorũ" is copied as printed. The first line at the top is cut off and only partly visible; its words are illegible. The last line, "Acastus.", stands at the left foot, apart from the right-hand column of entries; it is transcribed as an index line. The page number "342" on the actionem line is printed under the entry; the final line's numbers are copied as printed.
